newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong head out on bail - Thai police.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong head out on bail - Thai police.

text.p: Thai police said on Thursday that Prasong Panichpakdi, president of property developer Somprasong Land Plc, had been released on bail after reporting to them for questioning on fraud charges.
"Police have decided to release him on bail because he wanted to fight the charges," said Police Major General Vinai Pao-in, who heads the Economic Crime Investigation Division.
Maj Gen Vinai said Prasong was released after he had put up land title deeds worth 11 million baht ($440,000) and 50,000 baht in cash to police as bail.
He said police had charged Prasong with falsifying the company's financial statements and selling land without a licence.
The second charge was made after three house buyers lodged complaints with police as they were questioning him, Vinai said.
After his release, Prasong told reporters he would counter the police charges in court.
"I have all the documents to fight this case," he added.
